title: Build the globby glob-matching engine from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the globby matching engine exactly as written in assets/gc-405/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-405/globby.py, without importing fnmatch or pathlib (the sealed suite scans the source). The spec's deliberately tricky globstar section (zero-segment **/, trailing /** excluding the bare head, in-segment ** demotion) and its character-class corner cases (]-first literals, negated classes that still refuse /, unclosed brackets, reversed ranges) defeat one-shot translations. Plan the segment/class grammar, build the translator or matcher, and iterate against the sealed suite until green, verifying each tricky family separately.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-405/plan.md exists before implementation, tabulating every wildcard/class/globstar rule with at least one positive and one negative example each.
workspace/gc-405/runs.log records every sealed-suite invocation with summary lines; at least one intermediate RED run before the final GREEN.
Failure identities: each failing test node id is logged with the matching rule it exposed and the change that fixed it.
Recovery after RED shown as diagnosis -> fix -> re-run; the sealed test file and its purity scan are never circumvented.
